results.input: Suppose I deposit 10 million VND for one year at a fixed annual interest rate of 4%, with interest paid at maturity. How much interest would I earn before taxes or fees?
results.response_preview:
To calculate the interest earned at maturity:

* **Principal:** 10,000,000 VND
* **Annual Interest Rate:** 4% (0.04)
* **Term:** 1 year

$$\text{Interest} = \text{Principal} \times \text{Rate} \times \text{Time}$$
$$\text{Interest} = 10,000,000 \text{ VND} \times 0.04 \times 1 = 400,000 \text{ VND}$
